purpose: Approved Ben portrait: motion and dialogue quality evaluation

review.source: Sampled frames preserve recognizable identity and show expression and raised-arm motion. Gesture and framing differ from restrained prompt; hand approaches edge. Not a multi-episode continuity pass.
review.lipsync: Rejected for production: visible lower-face/mouth softness in sampled speaking frame. No objective sync score; technical success does not establish convincing performance.
